sources: Hits, frames, keys and events: rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0017_yvonne_* and Json/BuffData buff_chr_0017_yvonne_* (commit 8b955ea), as compiled by efsim kit-draft (skillCompile.ts) and completed by hand where noted. Frames are SkillData frames (30 FPS) from the cast; projectiles land at their launch frame (travel isn't in the data: Ti2, in-game test 47). Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0017_yvonne.md (gap report, kit plan and the section "Kit").

Values: SkillPatchTable chr_0017_yvonne_* at the build's skill levels (level 12: attack1-4 atk_scale 0.53, 0.28 x2, 0.24 x3, 0.92; attack5 1.26, poise 17, atb 17; finisher 9.0 (BreakingAttackCalculation 0.1 / 0.9); dive 1.8; battle skill atk_scale 2.5, atk_scale2 1.5, atk_scale_layer 2.0, poise 10, usp_base 10, usp_layer 30, cost 100 SP; combo atk_scale_tick 1.0, atk_scale_boom 2.0, usp 10, usp_extra 10, poise 10, interval 0.75, maxcnt 4, cooldown 18 s; ultimate duration 7, cost 220, cooldown 10 s, atk_up / crit_dmg_up (P5 sets 0.1 / 0.3); ult attacks atk_scale 0.2 per shot, ult_attack1_1 normal_dmg_up 0.03, crit_rate_up 0.06, layer 10; end strike atk_scale 3.0, atk_scale_extra 6.0, poise 20). Talents (PotentialTalentEffectTable): talent 1 Barrage of Technology attaches chr_0017_yvonne_talent_1 (dmg_up 0 / 0.5), talent 2 Freezing Point attaches chr_0017_yvonne_talent_0 (inflict_up 0.1 / 0.2, status_up 0.2 / 0.4). Potentials: P1 combo radius, interval 0.5, maxcnt 6, usp_extra 25; P2 Intellect +20, Crit Rate +7% (stat panel); P3 talent_0 inflict_up +0.1, status_up +0.2; P4 normal_skill atb_return 10 (has_potential2); P5 ultimate atk_up 0.1, crit_dmg_up 0.3 (has_potential5).

Not kit skills: chr_0017_yvonne_dash_attack (+ _projhit) and its ultimate modes ult_dash / ult_dash_end (dash attacks: batch-3 S5, deferred), chr_0017_yvonne_dodge, chr_0017_yvonne_passive_0 (+ buff: attached by no talent node), the _potential_4 / _potential_5 skills and buffs (no potential attaches them: the dive's P5 branch and the ultimate's P4 branches read orphan buffs; both ultimate branches are identical), _normal_attack5_mark, _power_attack, _train_*, _combo_skill_tutorial_marker, shield / camera / voice / wep / environment / robot_end buffs, the three Tink-a-Bella entities (no actions), buff_chr_0017_yvonne_normal_skill_frozen (its DamageAction is disabled: it is only the buff talent 1 listens for).

buffs.label: Freezing Point (talent 2): Crit DMG vs Cryo Infliction, doubled vs Solidification
buffs.note: buff_chr_0017_yvonne_talent_0 (lifeType 1, permanent) damageModifier, judged at each damage: target with Cryo Infliction and not Solidified -> Critical DMG +inflict_up; Solidified (with or without Cryo) -> +status_up (2 x inflict_up: 'doubled against enemies with Solidification'). P3 raises both (skillBbModifiers on the talent skill).

buffs.label: Barrage of Technology (talent 1): the next basic attack is a Final Strike (attack5), DMG +dmg_up
buffs.note: buff_chr_0017_yvonne_talent_1_valid: 15 s (literal duration), stackingType 4. Its buffEvent 5 ComboCacheAction maps the basic-attack input to attack5 while it's enabled (the loader sets basicAttack from it: S8); abilityEvent 30 + CheckSkillId attack5 -> CreateBuffAttachingSkill _talent_1_valid_up (DamageScaleProcessor NormalCalcZone +dmg_up) for that cast; attack5 ends it at frame 21 (FinishBuffAction). Kit: consumed by the next basic cast, which the mapping makes attack5 (a finisher, also of kind basic and not mapped, would consume it too: an edge case, noted in the report). How long the mapping holds (the whole buff, or the ComboCacheAction's cacheTime 0.5 s): in-game test 79; the kit takes the whole buff.

buffs.label: Cryoblasting Pistolier (ultimate state: enhanced basic attacks)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0017_yvonne_ultimate_skill (from the ultimate's frame 61, `duration` 7 s): while enabled SwitchModeAction 'ult' (basic attacks become ult_attack1_1 -> 2_1 -> 2_2 -> 3_1 -> 3_2 ...: the attack skills' `available`) and RefrainObtainUsp (blocksEnergy). P5: child buff_chr_0017_yvonne_potential_5_new (ATK formulaItem 6 +atk_up, Critical DMG +crit_dmg_up) when has_potential5 >= 1, on this state and on the end state; its finish creates the end state.

buffs.label: Ultimate end state (the next basic attack is the enhanced Final Strike)
buffs.note: buff_chr_0017_yvonne_ultimate_skill_end: 3 s (literal); while enabled ComboCacheAction -> ult_attack_end (the loader sets basicAttack: S8), RefrainObtainUsp, the P5 child buff; its finish ends the layers and sets the ultimate's cooldown to 10 s (SetSkillCdAtOnce skillTypeMask 128, functionType 1, value 10: trigger ult_cooldown).

buffs.label: Ultimate layers: Crit Rate per layer, Crit DMG per layer at 10
buffs.note: buff_chr_0017_yvonne_ultimate_skill_layer: stackingType 8 (layers on one timer that each new layer refreshes: the loader sets sharedTimer; batch-3 B3, test 62 / Y3), maxStackCnt 10 (= ult_attack1_1 `layer`), duration recycle_time 4 s (the buff's blackboard: literal). Critical Rate (attr 9) +normal_dmg_up per layer; Critical DMG (attr 10) +crit_rate_up_dynamic per layer, set to crit_rate_up by buffEvent 6 once at 10 layers (RefreshBuffAttrModifierValue). A layer comes with each enhanced shot's launch (not 2_1's at 21 nor 2_2's at 11) and at the end strike's frame 0.

triggers.note: CharGrowthTable COMBO TRIGGER: 'When the controlled operator performs a Final Strike on an enemy with Solidification.'

buff_chr_0017_yvonne_talent_1: abilityEvent 102 on buff_chr_0017_yvonne_normal_skill_frozen, which her battle skill's listener (abilityEvent 206 + tag Solidification + CheckSkillCastId) puts on the enemy when that cast applies Solidification: 'After applying Solidification, the next basic attack directly becomes a Final Strike'. Only her battle skill's Solidification counts (the combo's explosion doesn't).
chr_0017_yvonne_ultimate_skill frame 61: CreateBuff buff_chr_0017_yvonne_ultimate_skill (and the empty _full_effect).
buff_chr_0017_yvonne_ultimate_skill_end finish: FinishBuff the layers (and shield / environment / potential4_valid / full_effect, no gameplay), SetSkillCdAtOnce ultimate 10 s (literal in the buff).

chr_0017_yvonne_ult_attack_end [28-31]: FinishBuffAction on the end state and the layers. It starts on the same frame as the strike's damage [28-60] (both hits); the kit runs the damage first (file order: the damage clip is timelineActions[5], the FinishBuff [10]; the layers, P5 and the end state still act on both hits; row 26, open, a log decides): at frame 28 after the frame's hits (afterHits).

skills.label: Basic attack 1
skills.note: Projectiles (LaunchProjectile -> *_projhit, DamageAction atk_scale, mask 128) land at their launch frame. In the ultimate state the basic-attack input is the enhanced chain (SwitchModeAction 'ult' in buff_chr_0017_yvonne_ultimate_skill): `available` not ult_state. The talent-1 and end-state mappings (S8) need no `available`. Its window 0-27 listing attack5 makes no chain step (its ComboCacheAction maps the input to attack2 only: S8).

skills.label: Basic attack 4
skills.note: TogglableAction [0-24] -> AllowNextSkill attack5 while buff_chr_0017_yvonne_talent_1_valid (S9: judged at the cast, the toggle in the game follows the buff). The projectile's castSkillOnBlock is the same projhit (one landing, not a second).

skills.label: Basic attack 5 (Final Strike)
skills.note: A chain step after attack4 (attack4's ComboCacheAction maps it), or the talent-1 Final Strike while barrage maps the input. IfElse on the ultimate states: AllowNext 34-60 -> ult_attack2_1 in one, else 37-60 -> attack1.

hits.note: ChannelingAction 21-23 (once per target) -> DamageAction atk_scale (mask 2097280: Final Strike); IfElse CheckMainCharacter -> poise unit `poise` and ObtainCostAction atb (natural) once.

skills.label: Dive attack
skills.note: IfElse on buff_chr_0017_yvonne_potential_5 (an orphan: no potential attaches it) -> the plain DamageAction atk_scale (mask 1152). Not castable until dive attacks are (batch-1 S10).

dataOverride.poise: Kit right: the dive's first IfElse side (with poise) reads buff_chr_0017_yvonne_potential_5, which nothing attaches (an orphan); the side that runs is the plain DamageAction atk_scale without poise. The match takes the first side.

skills.label: Battle skill: Brr-Brr-Bomb
skills.note: chr_0017_yvonne_normal_skill: buff _projectile (frame 5, 1 s, autoFinishByAction) launches the bomb at its finish (frame 35, or when her skill ends sooner: the kit lands it at 35 either way, detached). normal_skill_projhit: IfElse has_potential2 and one target: ForEach target: IfElse Cryo (1570888476) or Nature (-1411846745) Infliction >= 1: SaveBuffStackNum -> count, ForceSpellStatusAction Solidification consumedLayer count (consumption, then a forced Solidification at that level, before the DamageAction), atk_scale_final = atk_scale_layer x count + atk_scale + atk_scale2; else DamageAction atk_scale. After the loop: ObtainCostAction usp_base + usp_layer x max_count if max_count > 0 ('only 1 time'); P4: atb_return returned SP when it hits one enemy (the simulator's single target).

skills.label: Combo skill: Flashfreezer
skills.note: chr_0017_yvonne_combo_skill spawns abilityentity combo_skill_abilityrange (frame 0); entity frame 19: ObtainCostAction usp (a target in radius) and CreateBuff buff_chr_0017_yvonne_combo_skill (3 s, triggerInterval `interval`, maxTriggerCnt `maxcnt`, first tick at once: PullAction, DamageAction atk_scale_tick on three branches with identical damage, ObtainCostAction usp_extra once); its finish -> buff_chr_0017_yvonne_combo_skill_finish (first tick 0.5 s later, frame 124): CreateBuff buff_common_cryst_cryst_frozen_triggered (level 1, extra_duration 2) before DamageAction atk_scale_boom + poise; its energy only if no tick hit (never against one target in range). P1: interval 0.5, maxcnt 6.

skills.label: Ultimate: Cryoblasting Pistolier
skills.note: No hits of its own: FinishBuff of both states at 0, UltimateTimeAction and RefrainObtainUsp 0-61 (energyBlockSeconds 61 frames), damage immunity 0-64; at 61 the state (trigger ult_state). 'makes Yvonne the controlled operator'.

skills.label: Enhanced basic attack 1
skills.note: Enhanced basic attack (ultimate group, basic-attack decorate mask 128): one entry per projectile at its launch frame; a layer with each launch (CreateBuff _ultimate_skill_layer beside the LaunchProjectile) where the data has one. The CheckHp / CheckEntityNum branches only pick the target.

The CheckHp / CheckEntityNum branches only pick the target. No layer with the frame-21 launch.

The CheckHp / CheckEntityNum branches only pick the target. Shots 1 and 3 can fly as either projectile (CheckHp branches: either key in a log). No layer with the frame-11 launch.

The CheckHp / CheckEntityNum branches only pick the target.

skills.note: Enhanced basic attack (ultimate group, basic-attack decorate mask 128): one entry per projectile at its launch frame; a layer with each launch (CreateBuff _ultimate_skill_layer beside the LaunchProjectile) where the data has one. The CheckHp / CheckEntityNum branches only pick the target.

skills.label: Enhanced Final Strike
skills.note: The end state maps the basic-attack input to it (S8). [28-60] IfElse end state >= 1: DamageAction atk_scale (mask 2101376: Final Strike) + poise 20 (the kit's branch: it's cast in the end state, and the layers act on it), else the same with processors Crit Rate +normal_dmg_up x layers, Crit DMG +crit_rate_up (not reachable in the kit: row 26 is which branch the game takes); then ForEach Solidified target: DamageAction atk_scale_extra (mask 128) and FinishBuffAdvanced tag Solidification.

hits.note: 'If the enemy is Solidified, Yvonne performs an additional attack ... and then consumes the enemy's Solidification' (FinishBuffAdvanced after the DamageAction).
